description:
V00.75 contract test suites (JUnit-5 @Test default interfaces) for
    the seven Security Event Bus SPIs: PayloadCodec, SignatureAlgorithm,
    KeyManagement, ReplayStore, SequenceStore, ProducerPolicy,
    EventStore. Persistence-tech-agnostic — every adapter
    implementation hands a fresh SPI instance into a newStore() method
    and inherits the full contract.
